steps.text: To add a piece by hand, tap Add Item on Home.
Your collection opens. Tap the round add button.
Pick the kind of piece. Coins is already picked.
Fill in what you know. Here, the denomination, the year, and the series.
Scroll down to Estimated Value and type what it's worth.
Type what you paid under Purchase price.
Tap Save Item. The piece is in your vault, and the vault total goes up.
